src_new='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    for keyf, dirs in ((lambda r, c: r - c, ((1, 1), (-1, -1))),
                       (lambda r, c: r + c, ((1, -1), (-1, 1)))):
        lines = defaultdict(list)
        for r, c, v in cells:
            lines[keyf(r, c)].append((r, c, v))
        for line in lines.values():
            line.sort()
            n = len(line)
            if n < 2:
                continue
            # maximal same-color runs
            runs = []
            i = 0
            while i < n:
                j = i
                while j + 1 < n and line[j + 1][2] == line[i][2] and \\
                        abs(line[j + 1][0] - line[j][0]) == 1:
                    j += 1
                runs.append((i, j))
                i = j + 1
            for i, j in runs:
                if j - i + 1 < 2:
                    continue
                v = line[i][2]
                # blocked if any other non-bg cell lies beyond that end on the line
                up_blocked = i > 0
                down_blocked = j < n - 1
                if up_blocked and not down_blocked:
                    dr, dc = dirs[1]  # extend upward
                    r0, c0 = line[i][0] - dr, line[i][1] - dc
                elif down_blocked and not up_blocked:
                    dr, dc = dirs[0]  # extend downward
                    r0, c0 = line[j][0] + dr, line[j][1] + dc
                elif not up_blocked and not down_blocked:
                    dr, dc = dirs[0]  # isolated run: extend downward
                    r0, c0 = line[j][0] + dr, line[j][1] + dc
                else:
                    continue  # blocked both sides
                r, c = r0, c0
                while 0 <= r < R and 0 <= c < C:
                    out[r][c] = v
                    r += dr
                    c += dc
    return out
'''
